channel.title: Parallax
channel.description: Same event, different vantage points. Geopolitical news compared across Western, Eastern, Middle Eastern and Russian outlets.

item.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza result in multiple casualties according to various reports.
item.description: On November 1, 2026, Israeli missile and drone strikes in Gaza City and Khan Yunis killed at least eight people, including one child. While all outlets confirm the casualties, coverage diverges significantly in framing. Western sources focus on military objectives and tactical details regarding targets like Hamas and local police. In contrast, Middle Eastern sources emphasize the humanitarian impact, highlighting the systematic destruction of infrastructure and the broader scale of civilian casualties since the 2025 ceasefire.

item.title: Independent Russian newspaper Novaya Gazeta announces the closure of its Russian edition.
item.description: Independent Russian newspaper *Novaya Gazeta* announced the closure of its Russian edition on October 30, 2026, with operations set to cease on November 9. Both Western and Russian outlets confirm the shutdown follows intense state pressure and restrictions regarding war reporting. Western sources frame the closure as a deliberate campaign of state repression against independent voices, while Russian reporting emphasizes the loss of a historic institution and the practical logistical hurdles of maintaining editorial independence.
